definitions.short: a rill (i.e. small channel of water, as in irrigation)
definitions.full: H6388. peleg I. מֶּ֫לֶג noun masculine Psa 65:10 (cleft) channel , (artificial) canal ; — usually plural מְּלָנִים Isa 30:25 ( + יִבְלֵימָֿ֑יִם ); construct מַּלְגֵימַֿיִם Psa 1:3 , simile Isa 32:2 ; Prov 21:1 , metaphor 5:16 , of tears Lam 3:48 ; Psa 119:136 ; מְּלָגָיו 46:5 (i.e. irrigating canals from river, metaphor); מַּלְגֵישָֿׁ֑מֶן Job 29:6 (figurative of prosperity); singular אֱלֹהִים מֶּלֶג Psa 65:10 , poetic of channel for rain (compare Job 38:25 ).

occurrences.englishText: when my steps were washed with butter,
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water,
God is within her. She shall not be moved.
Streams of tears run down my eyes,
Should your springs overflow in the streets,
The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses.
There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind,
My eye runs down with streams of water,
